motif: A single round Verde-Necromante (#39FF14) resin wound, like an eye or valve, glowing at the heart of every building. It is rimmed in Seiva Negra black and set in split, cracked trunk-wood.

buildings.why: Trunk-tower base of the Ancient chain. Its Casca Pútrida olive reads as living tree.
Same tall tower grown into a wide antler crown around the circular resin wound. Black separates it from its neighbours.
Mid-chain tower, taller and with more branches. It returns to the chain's olive and is not adjacent to h04V.
The card gives no shape, so a squat bark-wrapped drum fills the gap. Pale bone makes it stand out.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: The kneeling figure plus its split back-snag gives a two-to-three-peak cluster. Stone and wood blend, with the chest cavity glowing.
The rib of branches around the resin diaphragm forms a hollow crown. Red-coral is the warm accent.
The split fallen trunk forms a low den, with one dead snag as the only vertical.
A half-submerged root bulb sits in a pit rim. Pale clay contrasts with the dark neighbours.
One low bent root arch over two pods is the gate silhouette. Brass-green is a distinct metal hue.
The same arch grown into two tall pylons around the bladder. Iron differs from the brass of its predecessor.
The crooked perch above the collapsed nest leans hard. Pale bone sets it apart from the neighbouring iron.
Chain of Void Portal. The tall double husk grows from a dome base into a wide shell around the basin. Plum is a new hue.
Chain of Nether Ancient. The two crossed downturned crescents lean harder around the high trunk. It returns to the chain's bone colour.
The low round basin under a root arch is a squat dome. It keeps the chain's plum.
The rack of charge pods above the basin stacks into terraces, with one spike on top. The warm red echoes h04T but they are far apart in build order.
